title: Collaborative Document Workbench customer commissioning

task.name: Commission a complete tenant-scoped collaborative document service and independently receive its editable history
task.purpose: Give the customer’s document owner, authorized editors and independent receiver a complete native collaborative workspace: original source intake and migration, explicit tenant/document grants, real shared and offline editing, durable binary storage, controlled rollback/restore and a portable editable handover.
task.request: Receive the actual customer Workshare, complete source documents, original schema and required document population. Establish accountable document owners, tenant identities, editor/viewer identities and explicit document grants. Retain original filenames, formats, full bytes/SHA-256, provenance and source-use authority. Prepare and independently receive the exact original locked Node/Hocuspocus/Tiptap/Yjs runtime through its maintained installer; use each returned application directory and that host’s freshly generated build/runtime-ready receipt. Review source/configuration editions and original JSON, HTML or Yjs mappings against the installed schema. Review every migration row and use the native transformer to import the complete selected population into new logical documents. Start the original deployment under Applications. Operate two authorized original browser clients, concurrent edits, one real offline/reload/reconnect sequence and explicit durable-state checks. Confirm that the full native Yjs update bytes and state vector are retained, and that read-only and other-tenant actors cannot write or read unauthorized documents. Retain an original drained checkpoint. Demonstrate configuration rollback preserving current content, and only when explicitly commissioned demonstrate content restore into a new physical epoch that excludes prior offline edits. Create complete named handoffs containing source, binary documents, checkpoints and attributed project/request history. Independently receive and reopen the same project with receiving-host authentication/runtime, explicitly start its original deployment, and continue a useful document revision. Expose the same authorized operations and complete files through the private Merchant agent. Record actual Installation observations only after those original operations complete.
task.completeOutput: One complete commissioned customer document service and accepted document edition, with every agreed source and migrated document, tenant/grant/mapping/edition history, full persisted Yjs binary states and checkpoints, actual collaboration/offline/revocation/restore results, managed browser and agent operation, and a complete independently received editable application/runtime/project handover.
task.repeatTrigger: A real new or revised customer document population, recurring reviewed publication, agreed tenant onboarding or explicit schema/configuration change creates a linked useful task. Individual keystrokes, retransmitted websocket messages, retries, duplicate downloads and alternate export formats continue the same task and do not count as additional purchases.
task.pricedUnit: One explicitly agreed whole commissioning or document-edition task covering its complete population, authorized users and editable handover. Use the existing Installation’s actual merchant unit, atomic amount/count/budget and approved spending selection. Professional adaptation, ongoing hosting, supported schema changes and support remain explicit original Workshare terms.

source.reference: Select the complete original customer document set and schema, source authority, existing Workshare and actual Installation packet. Retain source URLs or acquisition references, timestamps, filenames, formats, full bytes/SHA-256 and the exact project/source/edition/migration identities.
source.mode: Original Tiptap JSON, HTML or Yjs-update input through the selected installed schema and native transformer. Retain complete input and explicit mapping/review. Native multi-client and offline synchronization uses original Hocuspocus/Yjs/y-indexeddb. Unsupported schema nodes/marks/attributes remain visible errors requiring an explicit supported source/schema decision.
source.population: Every source document, tenant, logical target and authorized actor/grant agreed in the Workshare. Retain the complete row review, including skipped/error rows and reasons. Respect the original 512 MiB upload and 32 MiB individual-document limits; split a legitimate larger population into explicit original inputs without discarding members or presenting a sample as the full delivery.
source.meaning: Keep tenant and logical document identities, schema/field selection, original rich-text semantics, source provenance, actor attribution and exact document epochs. A project operator has administrative permission but still needs an explicit matching tenant/document grant for live editing or persistence. Storage confirmation binds both full Y.encodeStateAsUpdate bytes/SHA/length and state vector. Configuration rollback and content restore are distinct native operations; a restore creates a new epoch and retains the previous history.
source.changePolicy: Retain original source and frozen edition identities. Use original request/revision review for changes to mapping, configuration, actors/grants and document restoration. Revoke or change grants through the application so existing sessions are rechecked. Do not reuse old-epoch offline caches after restore. New runtime/schema selection is an explicit supported change with complete source and receiving, not an implicit package update.

receiving.application: TJLabs Collaborative Document Workbench, with all 50 unchanged original files from Commons fce1f8b787822513fb1b8a1ed77f41c5f2322fae retained under products/collaborative-documents/workbench. Installed commands: collaborative-documents, collaborative-documents-prepare, collaborative-documents-managed and collaborative-documents-receive. The managed launch selects the actual original preparer’s returned applicationDirectory and host-specific runtimeReadyFile.
receiving.acceptanceRule: The complete agreed source population is retained and every migration row is reviewed; imported documents match their explicit tenant/schema/mapping. Two original clients demonstrate real collaboration and offline recovery, full binary/vector durability and current authorization. Native checkpoints and any commissioned restore preserve original history and correct epoch isolation. Browser and Merchant agent operate the same original project; the agent retains full requests and files without bypassing changed grants. Full runtime/application/project packages are independently received, reopened and explicitly started by the receiving host. Only observed completed outcomes enter Installation acceptance.
receiving.changeAndWithdraw: The authorized operator updates the original project/revision and explicit grants. Stop through Applications to drain original native owners. Configuration rollback preserves content; document.restore requires a selected checkpoint, reason, document set and new_epoch. Keep original and restored histories. Use the original Installation change/return process for population, authority, commercial scope or ongoing-service changes.
receiving.recovery: Keep the original actor, request ID, expected revision and complete payload after uncertainty. Read the native actor-scoped request receipt before replacing an operation. Resume the same upload from its committed exact offset. Reconcile and explicitly resume the original closed failed/interrupted job. A received source-host job cannot start on the receiver. Rebuild/reobserve the exact installed runtime at each returned application path; never relocate source-host ready files or node_modules. Cached agent content must recheck current original actor and all retained document grants.
receiving.maintenance: Assign document owner, adaptation engineer, original runtime/operator owner and independent receiver in the existing case. Deliver complete editable source, dependency/lock identities, licenses, actual installed runtime, binary documents/checkpoints, configuration guidance and support boundaries. Keep auth files, provider tokens, connection records and session secrets outside public/customer project exports. The reusable TJLabs workbench does not imply third-party endorsement or a licensed Pro feature.

steps.title: Receive the complete Workshare and document authority
steps.result: Use the current original case/Workshare-derived seed. Retain all commercial phases, funded assignments and real payment selections. List the complete document population, source authority, schema/field, tenant/actor scope and independent receiving owner.

steps.title: Prepare and independently receive the original runtime
steps.result: Verify all 50 unchanged source files and exact dependency lock. Run the original preparation/export/receive and original install/build at each returned application directory. Retain that host’s actual Node executable, package/module paths, build-manifest and runtime-ready.

steps.title: Retain original source and explicit tenant/grant scope
steps.result: Upload full original documents with bytes/SHA and committed-range replay. Retain source roles and provenance. Create exact tenant IDs and explicit per-actor read/write grants; empty document IDs mean that tenant only. Keep all credentials private.

steps.title: Review and freeze source/configuration edition
steps.result: Select original retained source IDs, reference-v1/default or a separately commissioned supported schema, native debounce/size/origin settings and complete runtime identity. Freeze the original edition before import/deployment.

steps.title: Map and review every source document
steps.result: Plan JSON/HTML/Yjs import using the original transformer and installed schema. Review every ready/error/skipped row, target tenant/logical name/title and reason. Select new logical documents; do not overwrite existing targets implicitly.

steps.title: Operate original import and managed deployment
steps.result: Apply the reviewed native migration and retain its actual job/attempt/files. Prepare/start the original deployment under the single Applications owner. Reconcile stopped/interrupted owners and explicitly resume the same job or deployment when permitted.

steps.title: Demonstrate complete collaborative and offline editing
steps.result: Use two authorized native browser clients and the actual document population. Operate concurrent edits, offline disconnect, local reload and reconnect. Confirm full update SHA/length plus vector in persisted receipts. Show denied read/write and current grant revocation with appropriate actors.

steps.title: Checkpoint, roll back and explicitly restore when commissioned
steps.result: Drain and retain the original checkpoint and full binaries. Demonstrate configuration rollback preserving current data. If authorized, restore selected documents from that checkpoint into new physical epochs, preserve both histories and prevent old offline edits entering the new target.

steps.title: Operate the same customer workspace through the Merchant agent
steps.result: Connect only declared original aliases. Read full current/historical projects and authorized documents; retain exact requests before action; reconcile native receipts; stream declared inputs and complete original artifacts. Recheck current grants before cached content is returned.

steps.title: Independently receive and reopen a useful complete edition
steps.result: Create named original gzip handoffs after native closure. Receive fresh/forward/same/older through original rules; preserve original project/request/source/binary history. Bind receiving-host auth and runtime, explicitly start, reopen the editor and continue a real customer document revision.

steps.title: Save observed Installation outcomes and continuation
steps.result: Use original fresh case/version preview/save. Record actual work/task/purchase/outcome IDs and actual receive/reopen evidence. Export and independently receive the whole Operations case, retain agreed support and identify the next useful customer task.

inputs: Current complete customer Workshare, commissioning/receiving packet, original commercial phases, accountable owners, effort/terms and current SCF case/plan.
All authorized original JSON, HTML or Yjs documents with full file bytes/SHA, provenance and complete intended document population.
Actual schema/field and supported content requirements, tenant/logical document names and original import mapping.
Real operator/editor/viewer identities, tenant memberships, explicit document grants and their approval/revocation owner; private auth input never included in project handoff.
Exact original 50-file source manifest, package/lock/license, prepared/exported/received runtime and each returned application’s build/runtime-ready receipt.
Full original source/configuration editions, migration row decisions, native job/attempt IDs and resulting binary/document identities.
Original two-client/offline/durable-save/authorization observations, actual screenshots/rendered inspection and complete browser artifacts.
Original drained checkpoint binaries and an explicit restore reason/document set only when content restoration is commissioned.
Complete named handoffs, actual independent receiver/runtime/auth selection and cold reopen output for the same project.
Actual merchant/buyer deployment, source-use authority, asset/network/recipient, integer atomic amount/count/budget and authorized spending selection.
